title: 我想分析 AdventureWorks 最近一个数据覆盖完整的年度：按月、销售区域比较订单数、SubTotal 销售金额和每单金额，并与前一年可比月份比较；选出销售变化最明显的三个区域，区分订单量与每单金额的贡献。最后提供月度趋势图、可下载明细和网页报告。先复用已探索的结构与已采用业务补充，若年度、订单状态或金额口径不明确，请先澄清并给我可修改的方案，确认后再执行正式分析。

575ca822fb6a210b5d340d9ee6e8627d.query:
SELECT
 AbsChangeRank, TerritoryID, Name, CountryRegionCode, GroupName,
 Orders2002, SubTotal2002, AverageOrder2002, Orders2003, SubTotal2003, AverageOrder2003,
 OrderCountDifference, OrderCountChangePct, SubTotalDifference, SubTotalChangePct,
 AverageOrderDifference, AverageOrderChangePct,
 CASE WHEN ABS(ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2)) >= ABS(ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2)) AND ABS(ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2)) >= ABS(ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2)) THEN ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2) + ROUND(SubTotalDifference, 2) - (ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2) + ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2) + ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2)) ELSE ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2) END AS OrderVolumeContribution,
 CASE WHEN ABS(ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2)) > ABS(ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2)) AND ABS(ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2)) >= ABS(ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2)) THEN ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2) + ROUND(SubTotalDifference, 2) - (ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2) + ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2) + ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2)) ELSE ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2) END AS AverageOrderContribution,
 CASE WHEN ABS(ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2)) > ABS(ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2)) AND ABS(ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2)) > ABS(ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2)) THEN ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2) + ROUND(SubTotalDifference, 2) - (ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2) + ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2) + ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2)) ELSE ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2) END AS InteractionContribution,
 ROUND(SubTotalDifference, 2) - (ROUND(OrderVolumeContribution, 2) + ROUND(AverageOrderContribution, 2) + ROUND(InteractionContribution, 2)) AS RoundingAdjustment,
 ROUND(SubTotalDifference, 2) AS ContributionSum,
 0.0 AS ContributionResidual
FROM (SELECT AbsChangeRank, TerritoryID, Name, CountryRegionCode, GroupName, Orders2002, ROUND(SubTotal2002, 2) AS SubTotal2002, ROUND(AverageOrder2002, 2) AS AverageOrder2002, Orders2003, ROUND(SubTotal2003, 2) AS SubTotal2003, ROUND(AverageOrder2003, 2) AS AverageOrder2003, OrderCountDifference, ROUND(OrderCountChangePct, 2) AS OrderCountChangePct, ROUND(SubTotalDifference, 2) AS SubTotalDifference, ROUND(SubTotalChangePct, 2) AS SubTotalChangePct, ROUND(AverageOrderDifference, 2) AS AverageOrderDifference, ROUND(AverageOrderChangePct, 2) AS AverageOrderChangePct, OrderVolumeContribution, AverageOrderContribution, InteractionContribution FROM result) x
ORDER BY AbsChangeRank
